scientific_limitations: Exact classification applies to zero-padded finite factors of one-sided binary Sturmian words with irrational symbol-one frequency. Fixed-window VC dimension two and general one-unit gap were established earlier; only the slope-specific variable-length classification and arithmetic support consequences are assessed. The full Muller 2005 text was unavailable. No independent audit.
title: A slope-sensitive shattering phase transition for zero-padded Sturmian factors
